title: Blocking external calls inside request loops
summary: Making sequential HTTP/API calls inside loops increases latency, ties up workers, and amplifies downstream load.
rationale: Ruby web apps often have limited worker/thread capacity. Sequential remote calls can hold capacity while doing little useful local work.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Batch requests, cache stable responses, move work to background jobs, add timeouts, or use controlled concurrency where appropriate.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
